title: Nice sophisticated cover
text: Nice sophisticated cover. This is a nice duvet cover, pretty color (dark blue, slightly purpley), looks well made. Fabric is think enough to feel substantial and is smooth. I like the subtitle stripes. I don't like that the buttons where you insert a duvet are along the bottom edge and not set back a foot like my old duvet cover, but you can't really tell when it's on the bed. We use the ties in the corners to keep the duvet in place. The cover is the same size as my duvet (possibly a bit bigger, which is fine) and hangs over the mattress nicely. Nice unisex duvet cover. The shams are also nice. I'm very happy with it.
